race.comment: ROCKCLIFF (1) finished third over 1006m at Donald last time out following a determined win when fresh from a spell two runs back. Has a lot of weight and drawn out but hard to tip against given the form he's in. KENTAHTEN (3) made an encouraging return at Bairnsdale and while he is yet to win in 6 second-up runs, he's placed 5 times so no reason he won't go well again here. CHELSEA TOFF (4) is also second-up, returning from a spell three weeks ago when she was beaten 5 lengths into fifth over 1000m at Ballarat Synthetic. She has won second-up, so this looks a good progression. DERELICT (2) has been building this prep and might be ready to show something fourth-up.
